yt_client_hint: Create your own OAuth client of type "Desktop app" in Google Cloud Console and enable the YouTube Data API v3 and YouTube Analytics API. The guide walks you through it.
yt_connect_hint: Your browser opens Google's consent screen. Pick the channel (or brand account) there; each run adds one channel.
yt_enable_reply_hint: Asks Google for permission to reply to and moderate comments (youtube.force-ssl) for this channel.
yt_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect {name}? MetaDash revokes its access at Google.
yt_delete_data: Also delete this channel's data from MetaDash
yt_privacy_note: MetaDash stores YouTube data only on this computer. Disconnecting revokes access and (by default) deletes the channel's data. You can also remove access in your Google Account.
